scope: Proposition 3.1 (Threefold contraction of an adjoint plus a Kähler class) of the manuscript “Abundance after nonvanishing for compact Kähler fourfolds” (preprints/Abundance-after-nonvanishing-for-compact-Kahler-fourfolds-September-27-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 034 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 89b5dd1a939cd7a6), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 9. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let (Z, Γ) be a normal connected compact Kähler klt threefold with effective rational boundary and actual Q-Cartier adjoint A = KZ + Γ. Suppose α = c1(A) + [ω] is nef, ω is Kähler. (3.1) Then there is a projective surjection f : Z → Y with f∗OZ = OY , where Y is normal compact Kähler with rational singularities, and a Kähler class [ωY ] satisfying α = f∗[ωY ]. The actual rational line −A is f-ample. A compact curve is contracted exactly when its α-degree is zero.
